body.x: Cocoon Innovations Introduces a Complete Line of Organizational Accessories Compatible With the Apple iPod Touch, iPhone, and MacBook

NEW YORK, Jan. 5 /PRNewswire/ -- Cocoon Innovations, LLC, a DMC Worldwide company and leading provider of original, organizational solutions, will roll out a new collection of modern accessories compatible with Apple products including the iPod, iPhone, and MacBook. At the 2010 Consumer Electronics Show iLounge, Cocoon will showcase an array of compelling products--all of which feature fresh ways to arrange your Apple devices and keep them protected. Known for products that offer innovative digital device storage, Cocoon is once again offering unmatched organization solutions for today's digital lifestyle.

Cocoon's expanded line of Apple accessories includes messenger bags and laptop cases that can accommodate both the 13" and the 15" MacBook. Each of these bags feature Cocoon's critically acclaimed GRID-IT!, a patent pending organization system made up of a unique weave of rubberized elastic bands that acts as an object retention system to keep accessories in place. Additional attributes may include a convenient pocket organizer and document pocket, removable pencil case, padded, expandable laptop compartments, adjustable, padded shoulder straps and a variety of fashionable color ways.

In addition to messenger bags and laptop cases, this new line includes an array of iPhone accessories in both soft and hard shell designs with convenient storage for credit/debit cards, ID card, cash or headphones, making life on the go lighter. All cases and pouches will be available in a variety of neutral and bright colors, and select cases will feature a molded cord winder for headphone management.

Cocoon products are an ideal solution for business travelers, students, busy moms, traveling tourists, and everyday tech junkies, protecting and organizing personal and digital devices. Each bag and case is designed with an organic, innovative shape, which serves as a protective shell to safely transport your virtual cargo and redefine the way you stay organized in an ever-increasing digital world. Cocoon's design language and style provides consumers with superior functioning bags and accessories that are also highly stylized. Wrapped in their Cocoon, today's precious personal cargo is good to go. Cocoon products are available at www.cocooninnovations.com and select retailers nationwide.
Look for Cocoon Innovations at CES 2010 in North Hall Booth #3610.

Cocoon Innovations, LLC was launched to innovate personal storage and organization for the digital world. Whether organizing digital devices, school supplies, or personal items, Cocoon offers a wide variety of products to address every need. The principles of Cocoon have a long history in the consumer electronics arena and have been designing, developing and distributing award-winning products for the last three decades.
